creerCompte.q: How do I create an account?
creerCompte.r: Tap “Create an account”, choose your profile (Individual or School / IPES), fill in your details, then enter the code received by SMS.

motDePasse.q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
motDePasse.r: On the sign-in page, tap “Forgot your password?” and enter your account’s number: a code is sent to you to choose a new password.

supprimer.q: How do I delete my account?
supprimer.r: Open Settings, then “Delete my account”. Your password is requested to confirm.

trouverFormation.q: How do I find a programme?
trouverFormation.r: Open School, search for an institution or a programme and a city, then refine with the filters: field, diploma, schedule.

verifie.r: YIBOLO has checked the institution’s official documents, such as its operating licence and its NIU.

contacter.q: How do I contact an institution?
contacter.r: On its page, tap “Contact”: you will find its phone number, its WhatsApp and its address.

tarifs.q: Does YIBOLO collect driving school fees?
tarifs.r: No. Fees are shown for your information; you pay them directly to the driving school.

choisirAuto.q: How do I choose a driving school?
choisirAuto.r: Open Driving schools, filter by licence and city, then look at the page: fees, session schedule and reviews.

donnerAvis.q: How do I leave a review?
donnerAvis.r: On the page, open the Reviews tab and tap “Leave my review”. Your review is published after being checked by YIBOLO.

favoris.q: Where can I find my favourites?
favoris.r: Tap the heart on an institution, a programme or a driving school: you will find them in “My favourites”.

ajouterEtablissement.q: My institution is not on YIBOLO. How do I add it?
ajouterEtablissement.r: Create a “School / IPES” account and attach your documents (operating licence, NIU). Your page is published after being checked by YIBOLO.

modifierFiche.q: How do I edit my institution’s page?
modifierFiche.r: In your professional space, open “Institution profile”. Some information is published after approval by YIBOLO.

a1.p1: These terms govern the use of YIBOLO, the training, expertise and employment platform in Central Africa. By creating an account or using YIBOLO, you accept them.

a2.p1: You create an “Individual” or “School / IPES” account with accurate information. Your phone number is confirmed by a code sent by SMS.
a2.p2: You keep your password secret. Anything done from your account is deemed to have been done by you.

a3.p1: YIBOLO lets you browse institutions, programmes and driving schools, save them as favourites, leave reviews and read experts’ posts. These services are for personal, non-commercial use only.

a4.p1: Each institution is responsible for the information it publishes: programmes, intakes, contact details. It provides the documents requested (operating licence, NIU).
a4.p2: Sensitive or regulatory information is published after approval by YIBOLO. The “Verified institution” badge shows that these documents have been checked.

a5.p1: Reviews and comments remain courteous and describe a real experience. Insulting, false or advertising content is forbidden.
a5.p2: Reviews are published after being checked by YIBOLO. Anyone can report a review or a post that raises a problem.

a6.p1: Driving school fees shown on YIBOLO are for information only. YIBOLO collects no payment: you pay the driving school directly.

a7.p1: YIBOLO only collects the information the service needs: identity, contact details, place of residence, preferences. It is never sold.
a7.p2: You can edit it in “My profile” and delete your account in “Settings”.

a8.p1: YIBOLO does its utmost to keep information accurate and up to date, without being able to guarantee the information provided by institutions. YIBOLO is not a party to enrolments made between you and an institution.

a9.p1: YIBOLO may update these terms. The date of the last update appears at the top of this page; in case of a significant change, you are informed by notification.

a10.p1: For any question about these terms, write to YIBOLO support from the “Help and contact” page.
